matla_en:
O Cupbearer, pass around the cup and fill it up,
For love seemed easy at first, but then came difficulties.
summary_en:
O seeker of the omen (Fal),
Your intention seems simple and easy, but it appears you have not paid attention to the full answer to it. It is better for you to consult with a knowledgeable person. In this way, the difficulties of the path will become easy for you. Proceed with effort, striving, faith, and heart-felt conviction. A great goal requires great effort. Maintain your peace of mind and do not let difficult conditions and the nonsensical words of ill-wishers make you confused or worried. Be patient and resilient until you achieve what you desire. In this journey, you will sometimes feel failure and despair, but this very despair will become the motivation for your success. Accept the guidance of knowledgeable people with all your heart. You are putting everything on the line to reach your beloved and desired goal. Know that with self-confidence, presence of heart, and trust in God, you will reach your wish.

matla_en:
Where is righteous conduct and where am I, the ruined drunkard?
See how vast the distance is between our paths!
summary_en:
O seeker of the omen (Fal),
Your intention is very specific, and on the path to reaching it, you have experienced many ups and downs. Now, be cautious of enemies and envious people whose beautiful veils and deceitful appearances are full of traps, seeking to cast the dust of failure upon your spirit, soul, and life. The world is temporary, and you must stand firm and advance with willpower and without hesitation or fear until you reach that light and illumination which dark-hearted people are incapable of understanding. On this path, there are many deadly places and dangers; however, by avoiding association with ill-intentioned and impure individuals, and likewise through patience and endurance, you will overcome the hardships. Do not grieve for past days, because there is a vast difference between your way and method of living and that of the dark-hearted, ignorant ones.

matla_en:
If that Shirazi Turk would take my heart in hand,
For her dark mole I would bestow Samarkand and Bukhara.
summary_en:
O seeker of the omen (Fal),
Your wish and goal are more valuable than all material and earthly treasures, for it brings contentment and happiness to you and is a precious gift in your life. You, too, must appreciate its value with all your heart and soul, because your existence is tied to contentment and peace. Enjoy this happiness and always remain patient. By forgiving, letting go, and forgetting hatred and anger, you will be freed from what torments you, and you can focus your inner strength on your desires. By freeing yourself from past memories and being released from bitter experiences, you become worthy of embracing true happiness; God keeps evil away from you.

matla_en:
Morning breeze, if you pass by the alley of my Beloved,
Bring me a waft of fragrance from her musky tresses.
summary_en:
O seeker of the omen (Fal),
You are worried and anxious about reaching your wish. With haste and rush, you might stray from the path of reason. It is better to make use of wisdom, insight, and your own knowledge. Patience is bitter, but it yields a sweet fruit. Through good nature, kindness, affection, and gentleness, everyone will be drawn to you. With peace and presence of mind, and by keeping company with like-minded companions, you will consistently find yourself on the path of progress. Be at peace with those around you, cultivate harmony, and avoid going at it alone so that you may benefit from the assistance and attention of friends and have them as your supporters. The sign of your well-being and goodness lies in affection and loyalty.

matla_en:
My heart is slipping from my hands—O people of heart, for God's sake!
Alas, this hidden secret is about to be revealed!
summary_en:
O seeker of the omen (Fal),
The days of hardship are coming to an end, and your circumstances are becoming favorable. Through the wisdom and insight that you acquire, you will regain everything you have lost through others. Attend to the needy so that you may enjoy greater blessings. Be generous to your friends, and treat your enemies with gentleness and forbearance. In times of poverty, practice contentment, dignity, and open-mindedness, which serve as a life-giving elixir during hard times. Ask God for favorable winds to blow so that the ship of your life may reach its destination.

matla_en:
Who will convey this prayer to the King's attendants?
"In gratitude for your sovereignty, do not drive the beggar from your sight."
summary_en:
O seeker of the omen (Fal),
The most beautiful message of love to you is to pay attention to the weak and be kind to the powerless. Your rival is devilish in enmity and devoid of human qualities; take refuge in God's grace from his ill-wishing, and beware of envious people and do not reveal your secret to just anyone. Listen to the guidance of friendship, which is a messenger of affection and love, as it wishes for your goodness and well-being. Learn to look at all of life through the window of love so that you may discover the secret of happiness. To offer comfort, send a gift to your beloved so that your message of love reaches them.

matla_en:
Sufi, come! For the wine goblet is a mirror;
Come behold the purity of the ruby-red wine.
summary_en:
O seeker of the omen (Fal),
Make your soul pure, make your existence free of hypocrisy, and stay away from excesses and side issues so that, with purity of heart and a sincere, present mind, you can enjoy your life without greed, excess, or negligence. Give up unattainable goals that are the root of fear, doubt, and turmoil, because whatever is meant for a person is tied to destiny and portion. Enjoy this short opportunity of life with joy and happiness, and make use of it according to your capacity and real capabilities. Do not let greed lead you astray with deceitful tricks away from your turn and destiny. Enjoy the youth of existence, for no pleasure or delight in this world is permanent or lasting. Do not be neglectful of your present moments. By consulting with experienced people, you will become prosperous.

matla_en:
Cupbearer, rise and pour the cup;
Throw dust upon the sorrow of the passing days.
summary_en:
O seeker of the omen (Fal),
Do not grieve for the past; regretting this world chains you down and holds you captive. The world is constantly changing and transforming, so be patient and resilient, and cast away pride and self-centeredness so that anxiety and sorrow move away from you. Look at life with a positive and pleasant perspective and make use of your available resources to discover your true inner wealth. You will not find anyone among those around you who is worthy of sharing your secrets, so do not confide the secrets of your heart to them; let silence be your confidant and companion. Be patient in the face of adversities. Dark days and nights will come to an end, and with trust in God, you will achieve what you desire.

matla_en:
Again the garden hath the splendor of the time of youth;
To the sweet-singing nightingale, the good news of the rose arrives.
summary_en:
O seeker of the omen (Fal),
Right now is a period of comfort and happiness for you, but do not be deceived by the superficial outward appearances and glitz and glamour of this transient world. Do not blame or criticize others, as through the turns and mocks of time, you too might find yourself in those same conditions. Treat everyone with respect and associate with righteous, godly people, for with their magnanimity and noble nature, they will support you through life's storms. Greed and excessive craving for wealth, status, and power will make you oblivious to the true reality of life. The material world is fleeting and temporary; seek only what is sufficient from the blessings of this world so that both your spirit and body remain in balance. Forget about past days so that you may be freed from their captivity and become the absolute master of your life's meaning.

matla_en:
Last night, from the mosque toward the wine-house our Spiritual Guide came;
O friends of the Path, after this, what is our strategy?
summary_en:
O seeker of the omen (Fal),
Your intention is very commendable and the path you have chosen is uniquely exceptional. Pursue your goal wholeheartedly with perseverance and the assistance of companions, moving forward decisively and without doubt, as all the means for it to happen are ready. Strive in your work with firm resolve and without paying attention to the judgment of others or worrying. Your past emotional setback was due to daydreams, illusions, and unrealistic desires. Banish the distress and turmoil of that period from yourself, for every adversity conceals a hidden success. Put your trust in God so that you may receive His grace, kindness, and favor, attaining all that you truly deserve. Signs of complete success lie ahead of you; the path you have chosen is the best one, and God Almighty is your companion and helper on this journey.

matla_en:
O Cupbearer, illuminate our cup with the light of wine!
O Minstrel, sing—for the world's affairs have turned to our heart's desire!
summary_en:
O seeker of the omen (Fal),
Everything is turning out according to your desire, and the world is moving in your favor. You were unaware of something that made you anxious, but soon you will learn about an unexpected and pleasant turn of events. Meeting and reuniting with a dear loved one will bring you immense joy and delight. You possess a kind heart and abundant affection that bring praise to others, making your goals, hopes, and desires radiant, elevating your presence above all. The greatness of your heart and the sincerity within you will unlock countless blessings. You look upon the world with clarity and humanity, wishing goodness and well-being for all, and this very quality will bring you endless blessings, prosperity, and joy.
